name: budget-router
description: Stop burning your weekly Claude limit by accident. Picks the model and effort for every prompt, turns your weekly limit into a daily budget with a wrap-up warning before the lock, and learns which cheaper setting is enough for your work. Local only; sharing anonymous counts to help it learn is optional.

classifier.title: Task classifier
classifier.description: haiku: a tiny Haiku call labels each prompt (more accurate). heuristic: keyword rules only (free, instant)

tierTrivial.title: Trivial tier
tierTrivial.description: model:effort for chit-chat, quick facts, one obvious command

tierLight.title: Light tier
tierLight.description: model:effort for small, fully specified edits and lookups

tierStandard.title: Standard tier
tierStandard.description: model:effort for normal coding, debugging, config work

tierDeep.title: Deep tier
tierDeep.description: model:effort for design, hard bugs, refactors, security, research

tierMax.title: Max tier
tierMax.description: model:effort when the prompt says think hard / ultrathink

wrapUpPercent.title: Wrap-up notice at
wrapUpPercent.description: Percent of today's budget at which one heads-up is given before the lock (0 switches it off)

warnPercent.title: First cap at (% of daily budget)
warnPercent.description: At this share of today's budget the cap below applies and an alert shows

criticalPercent.title: Second cap at (% of daily budget)
criticalPercent.description: At this share of today's budget the stricter cap applies

lockAtLimit.title: Lock at 100%
lockAtLimit.description: Refuse prompts once today's budget is spent, until local midnight (/budget unlock overrides for 1 hour)

includeFiveHour.title: Also cap on the 5-hour window
includeFiveHour.description: Apply the same caps when the 5-hour rate-limit window passes the thresholds (never locks on it)

haikuMaxContext.title: Haiku context ceiling (tokens)
haikuMaxContext.description: Above this conversation size Haiku is never chosen (Haiku 5.5 is priced at its low rate up to a 100k prompt)

stickyContext.title: Sticky above (tokens)
stickyContext.description: Above this conversation size a one-step model change is skipped, since switching models re-caches the whole context

haikuModel.title: Haiku model id
haikuModel.description: Alias or full model id for Haiku turns and the classifier

sonnetModel.title: Sonnet model id
sonnetModel.description: Alias or full model id for Sonnet turns

opusModel.title: Opus model id
opusModel.description: Alias or full model id for Opus turns

subagentModels.title: Subagent model rules
subagentModels.description: JSON object: agent type -> haiku|sonnet|opus. Used only when the Agent call names no model. {} turns the rules off.

hideAgentsAtCritical.title: Hide agent types past the second cap
hideAgentsAtCritical.description: Comma-separated agent types the model is not offered once usage passes the second threshold (empty = hide none)

logDecisions.title: Keep a decision log
logDecisions.description: Store routing decisions, subagent rules and per-turn token use (no prompt text) for /route why

agentHints.title: Suggest helper agents
agentHints.description: Add a one-line hint (log-triage, disk-auditor, repo-check, reviewer, scout) to prompts that fit them. Decided by keywords, no model call.

unrealRules.title: Unreal build rules
unrealRules.description: Prompts about UBT, linker, cook or packaging errors never run on the trivial or light tier

cacheWarmMinutes.title: Prompt cache warm for (minutes)
cacheWarmMinutes.description: A model switch on a long conversation is only avoided while the last turn ended less than this long ago (the cache lives about an hour on a subscription)

paceWarnHours.title: Pace warning horizon (hours)
paceWarnHours.description: Warn once a day when the last 90 minutes' pace would use up today's budget within this many hours

catalogHints.title: Tell me when an installed skill or agent fits
catalogHints.description: Show a notice naming an installed skill or agent whose description clearly matches the prompt (keyword ranking, no model call). It only tells you; nothing is sent to the model

escalateOnTrouble.title: Escalate when a turn goes badly
escalateOnTrouble.description: Raise effort, and after a longer run of failed tool calls the model, for the rest of that turn

escalateAfterErrors.title: Raise effort after (failed tool calls)
escalateAfterErrors.description: Failed tool calls in one turn before effort goes up one notch

escalateModelAfterErrors.title: Raise the model after (failed tool calls)
escalateModelAfterErrors.description: Failed tool calls in one turn before the model goes up one step (once per turn)

paceControl.title: Pace control
paceControl.description: A PI controller sheds one or two cost steps while you spend faster than an even day

dayStartHour.title: Active day starts (hour)
dayStartHour.description: Local hour the even-pace line starts at

dayEndHour.title: Active day ends (hour)
dayEndHour.description: Local hour the even-pace line reaches 100% of the daily budget

paceSlack.title: Pace slack (percentage points)
paceSlack.description: How far ahead of the even-pace line you may be before the controller reacts

idleGuard.title: Idle cache guard
idleGuard.description: off, warn (a notice when a long pause means the context must be re-written) or ask (also pauses that prompt once)

idleMinTokens.title: Idle guard minimum context
idleMinTokens.description: Only warn when the context is at least this many tokens

nudgeTokens.title: Large-context notice
nudgeTokens.description: Notice each time the context grows past a multiple of this many tokens (0 turns it off)

runbooks.title: Runbook memory
runbooks.description: Notice shell commands you repeat and let you save them as scripts with /runbook; matching prompts get a one-line pointer to your own script

runbookAfter.title: Offer a runbook after (runs)
runbookAfter.description: How many times the same command must run before it is offered

runbookDir.title: Runbook folder
runbookDir.description: Where /runbook save writes scripts (blank: .claude/runbooks in your home folder)

learn.title: Learn from outcomes
learn.description: Track which model and effort worked for each kind of prompt and move one step on evidence

learnMode.title: Learner mode
learnMode.description: live (cost-aware learner picks the model and effort), shadow (only logs what it would pick), classic (old success-rate learner) or off

priceTable.title: Learner price table
priceTable.description: JSON of USD per million tokens per family, for example {"opus":{"inp":4,"out":20,"read":0.2,"write":5}}; blank uses list prices by model id

inviteContribution.title: One-time invitation to share counts
inviteContribution.description: After about 60 learned turns, show one notice explaining how to share anonymous counts (never repeated)

qualityWeight.title: Learner quality weight
qualityWeight.description: Dollars of pain assigned to a failed turn while the daily budget is full; shrinks as the budget is used up

learnMinSamples.title: Learner minimum samples
learnMinSamples.description: Turns needed at a step before the learner trusts its record

learnExplore.title: Learner exploration
learnExplore.description: Chance (0 to 1) of trying one cheaper step where the current one has worked well

reflect.title: Cheap second opinion
reflect.description: Off by default. For unclear turns (one or two failed tool calls) ask Haiku whether the request was completed; this sends the first 300 characters of the prompt and 600 of the reply to Haiku through your own Claude account

reflectPerDay.title: Second opinions per day
reflectPerDay.description: Upper limit on those Haiku calls per day
